query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('left',r.source_id,'right',r.target_id,'orders',r.data->'orders','source',r.data->'source','lastEvent',r.data->'event_id') AS "pair!" FROM knowledge_relations r JOIN products p ON p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.id=r.source_id JOIN products q ON q.tenant=r.tenant AND q.id=r.target_id WHERE r.tenant=$1 AND r.kind='CO_PURCHASED' ORDER BY (r.data->>'orders')::bigint DESC,r.source_id,r.target_id LIMIT 24
